title: Explicit Two-Sided Eigenvalue Bounds for Schrödinger Operators with Singular Potentials via Finite Element Method
summary: We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first numerical algorithm for explicit, computable two-sided eigenvalue bounds for Schrödinger operators H = -Delta + V on R^N, N = 2,3, in the presence of both an unbounded potential and an unbounded domain. "Explicit" here means that all constants and ingredients are derived in closed form from the mesh, the potential, and a small set of explicit inequalities (Payne-Weinberger, Hardy, and explicit bounded-domain Sobolev embeddings); the conversion to fully verified(IEEE-754-safe, interval-arithmetic) enclosures is a separate verification step…
